title: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for WABC-FM | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave an interview to WABC-FM on 12 December 1970.

It was conducted by WABC reporter Howard Smith, who also worked for the Village Voice. He had spoken to Lennon and Ono on several prior occasions. The interview took place at the couple’s suite at the Regency Hotel in New York City.
